text.name: Fall of the Caliphate
text.rules: Record "caliphate falls". LIO spends 2 points. If "proxy war" has been recorded this game, SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: The Islamic State group took Mosul in June 2014 and declared a caliphate. A US-led coalition formed that September backed the forces that retook Mosul in July 2017 and Raqqa in October 2017; its last territory, Baghuz in Syria, fell on 23 March 2019.
